High-Performance Spray Dried Coriander Powder for Global Food Manufacturing

Tradenest Naturals provides premium spray dried coriander powder designed for high-efficiency food production. We manufacture this fine powder using advanced spray-drying technology. This process preserves the volatile aromatic oils and the vibrant natural color of the coriander seeds. Consequently, our powder offers superior flavor profiles compared to traditional ground spices. Because we focus on consistency, every batch meets strict industrial standards for solubility and flavor intensity.

Why Choose Our Spray Dried Coriander Powder?

As a leading spray dried coriander powder manufacturer, we understand that consistency is vital for large-scale food production. Traditional coriander powder often clumps or loses aroma over time. However, our spray-dried version remains free-flowing and highly stable. This makes it an ideal choice for automated dosing systems in snack manufacturing and seasoning production. Moreover, our process ensures that the essential oils are encapsulated, providing a long-lasting sensory experience in the final product. If you are looking for a bulk spray dried coriander powder supplier India, Tradenest Naturals offers the reliability you need. We source the finest coriander seeds directly from trusted agricultural networks. Then, we subject them to a controlled spray-drying process. This ensures that the end product is additive-free and 100% pure. Therefore, your formulations remain clean-label and highly appealing to health-conscious consumers.

Advanced Manufacturing and Quality Control

Our manufacturing facility utilizes state-of-the-art spray drying technology. First, we select premium coriander seeds. Second, we extract the essence through a controlled process. Third, we atomize the liquid extract into a hot air stream. As a result, the moisture is instantly removed, creating fine, uniform particles. This method prevents the heat damage often associated with traditional grinding. Quality is our cornerstone. We implement rigorous testing at every stage of production. For instance, we monitor moisture levels, particle size distribution, and microbial safety. In addition, we ensure batch-to-batch traceability. This level of control makes us a preferred spray dried coriander powder exporter for international brands. We strictly adhere to global food safety standards to ensure your peace of mind.

Versatile Industrial Applications

Our wholesale spray dried coriander powder serves a wide range of sectors. Because of its excellent solubility and fine texture, it is perfect for:
  • Seasoning Blends: Enhance snack seasonings, instant noodle masalas, and spice mixes.
  • Ready-to-Eat Meals: Add consistent flavor to gravies, soups, and sauces without clumping.
  • Beverage Industry: Use in specialized herbal or botanical drink formulations.
  • Meat Processing: Integrate seamlessly into marinades, sausages, and processed meat products.
  • Nutraceuticals: Utilize as a standardized botanical ingredient in health supplements.

Buyer Information and FAQ

We aim to make the procurement process as smooth as possible. Below are answers to common questions from our B2B partners:

What is the minimum order quantity for spray dried coriander powder?

We offer a flexible MOQ policy. While standard bulk orders are encouraged for cost efficiency, we can accommodate smaller quantities for specific R&D or private label needs. Please contact us for a tailored quote.

What certifications and quality standards apply?

We follow strict internal SOPs and global food safety practices. We ensure our products meet the microbial and chemical specifications required for international export. Specific certification documentation can be provided upon request.

What are the packaging and shelf-life options?

We provide various packaging solutions, including 25 kg bulk bags, HDPE containers, and custom private label pouches. Our vacuum-sealed or moisture-barrier packaging ensures a long shelf life, typically 12 to 24 months when stored correctly.

What are the typical specifications?

Our standard specifications include a fine mesh size (usually 80-100 mesh), low moisture content (below 5%), and high purity with no added fillers. Detailed technical data sheets are available for your quality team.

What is the lead time and how do I request a sample?

Lead times vary based on order volume and customization. However, we generally process bulk orders within 2-4 weeks. To request a sample or a formal quote, please reach out through our website contact form.
